title: A source beside the feed — the reader slides in, the feed stays

tasks.title: Post sources open beside the page; the page lays out by its own width

acs.text: WHEN a learner clicks the source of a post (in the timeline, on the post's page or on a profile) and the reader offers SurfaceHost 1.1 `openBeside` THE SYSTEM SHALL call `host.openBeside` with the reader's address for that source (the href from `commands.href`), not navigate away; the link is still a real `<a href>` to that address, and a modified click (new tab, new window) follows the href. WHEN the reader is 1.0 (no `openBeside`) THE SYSTEM SHALL send the reader there with `commands.go`, as before.
scenarios: AC-001 the source of a post opens beside the page

acs.text: WHILE the page is shown in the reader's column beside a text THE SYSTEM SHALL lay out by its own width, not the window's: the frame is a size container and the home page's two-column layout and the profile header's row appear only when the frame is wide enough, so a 360–540px column shows one tidy column.
scenarios: AC-002 the page lays out by its own width
